prompt: Create an original character design option sheet for Cat Tower, a cute mobile browser cat-stacking game. Exactly four cats in a spacious two-column two-row grid on uniform pale cream background, each completely separate and fully visible. Top-left sleepy cream cat with closed eyes, top-right smug ginger tabby with half-open eyes, bottom-left startled charcoal tuxedo with cream muzzle and chest, bottom-right happy smiling white-and-ginger calico. Warm friendly 2D flat storybook sticker illustration, bold clean dark cocoa outlines, pastel peach and sage accents, simple subtle warm shading, crisp at small mobile size. All four use the SAME broad horizontal rounded loaf silhouette, logical body width-to-height ratio 1.55:1, broad nearly flat top and flat base suitable for stacking, tiny triangular ears above, two tiny tucked paws, very short tail curled along the body INSIDE the silhouette. Each face centered in the front of body, readable tiny eyes and nose. NO upright tails, NO oval platforms, NO oval bases, NO ground shadow, NO circles behind cats, NO props, NO hats, NO floor, NO text, NO labels, NO watermarks, NO interface, NO additional cats. Keep consistent proportions, outline weight and lighting across all four. These are review concepts, not final transparent runtime sprites.
